verdict.rationale: The docs list an official GLTFLoader, so glTF import is a first-party documented capability. The evidence says nothing about FBX or USD import, and nothing shows how cleanly glTF assets actually load. That leaves only one of the three named formats covered. Missing for 10: FBX loader evidence, USD loader evidence, detailed glTF import docs (materials, animations, extensions), hands-on corroboration that imports are clean.
